changeHypothesis.summary: Q2 began with strong ESS cell demand and high utilization. 宁德时代's Q1 report converted that demand into a large positive earnings surprise with resilient profitability, while direct A-share battery peers showed weaker profit conversion. At the cutoff, CATL's measured forward valuation was not richer than the weaker peers and its stock had not materially rerated after the surprise.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Industry evidence showed full ESS order books/high utilization, and CATL's Q1 disclosures/analyst estimates indicated >200GWh total shipments with storage becoming a larger share and 2026 output expectations being revised upward.
disconfirmingEvidence: Lithium and other raw-material inflation can compress margin before price pass-through.
Storage demand could slow after inventory/buildout acceleration.
CATL's size can reduce incremental earnings torque even when the industry is strong.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Visible Alpha baseline cited by a pre-cutoff report expected Q1 revenue RMB123.06bn and attributable profit RMB17.87bn; actuals were RMB129.13bn and RMB20.74bn. EVE's Q1 was described as in line/slightly above expectations; Sunwoda's was basically in line but profit weak.
expectations.thesisExpectation: The ESS demand acceleration is converting into CATL volume and earnings faster and with better economics than peers, supporting further 2026 estimate revisions without requiring multiple expansion.
expectations.measurableGap: CATL Q1 profit was about 16% above the cited consensus baseline, while a frozen analyst estimate put 2026E PE around 19x and the Apr27 close was near the pre-report Apr15 close despite the surprise.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward PE plus earnings-surprise and unit-economics comparison versus direct battery peers.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: Pre-result Visible Alpha consensus cited Q1 revenue RMB123.06bn and attributable profit RMB17.87bn; the frozen analyst 2026E profit forecast after results was about RMB103bn.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Storage/commercial/overseas demand sustains volume growth while CATL maintains resilient unit profitability, allowing 2026 earnings to meet or exceed the raised post-Q1 baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: At roughly 18-19x 2026E earnings near the cutoff, CATL does not require a premium rerating; it needs sustained shipment growth and no material unit-profit deterioration to retain an edge over EVE/Sunwoda.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: If Q1 was a one-off mix/volume spike and raw-material inflation pushes unit profit down, earnings revisions can stall even though storage demand remains healthy.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Q2 shipment, margin and earnings updates should reveal whether the Q1 surprise persists within 20-60 trading days, with 120 days covering a second reporting cycle.
